title: Multiline plural dictionaries, test-page language, replaceable data files and the static starter token
why: A static catalog app hit four defects: dev SEO failed on multiline plural entries, brain test ignored the default language, built data JSON was baked into a hashed copy, and the static starter failed brain check.
changelog: renders components in the app's default language
keep their path in builds and get no hashed copy
uses the `--line` token instead of the nonexistent `--border`
